newsitem.title: FRANCE: No Eurostar trains before Monday after fire - SNCF.
newsitem.headline: No Eurostar trains before Monday after fire - SNCF.

text.p: French SNCF railways said on Wednesday that passenger rail links between Paris and London via the Channel Tunnel would stay closed at least until Monday after a fire two days ago on a freight train.

"Taking account of the prolonged closure of the Channel Tunnel, the Eurostar (rail) service is completely suspended for an as yet undetermined period, which ought to include the weekend of November 23-24," SNCF said in a statement.
"SNCF asks travellers who had reserved tickets for the weekend to put off their trips," it said. Tickets would either be refunded or transferred to another date.

Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel said earlier it hoped for a partial resumption of traffic as early as Wednesday, provided it got the green light from an intergovernmental commission oveseeing safety.
Apart from the Eurostar passenger service, which links London and Paris and London and Brussels, Eurotunnel operates trains that shuttle freight and cars between France and Britain.
